text:
jess: Customer (Acme) hitting a 409 on /v1/rerank when calling with model=redwood/semantic-two. Error: "ModelTypeMismatch: expected reranker, got embeddings-only". Customer says it used to work.
jess: attaching the curl they sent and the response body:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <key>" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood/semantic-two","query":"Which product is best?","documents":["Doc A","Doc B"]}'
```
Response (400/409):
```json
{"error":{"type":"ModelTypeMismatch","message":"Model redwood/semantic-two is embeddings-only; rerank endpoint requires a reranker model."}}
```
sam: which tenant / env is this? any tenant-specific aliasing? did they pin a version or using alias?
jess: acme-prod, tenant 1007. They call the alias name (redwood/semantic-two) not an explicit model id.
maria: digging in logs — I see an alias repoint job completed ~13:58Z that repointed redwood/semantic-two -> embed-2026-02-11-8b7f (an embeddings-only model). That was part of a bulk alias cleanup job. Looks like the job accidentally matched a similarly named embed model.
deploy-bot: deploy job repoint-alias-bulk-341 finished by dbot at 2026-03-16T13:58:12Z (changeset id: cs-8b7f)
alex: ouch. So the alias now resolves to an embeddings model which explains the mismatch. Can we safely repoint back to the reranker? what model id should we use?
maria: yes — the proper reranker version is rk-v2-20260221-9fa3b. I can repoint the alias back, but I'll run a quick validation first.
maria: quick plan: 1) repoint alias back to rk-v2-20260221-9fa3b 2) run small smoke rerank tests for tenant 1007 3) push a patch to the alias-repoint job to block repoints when model.type differs from alias.type.
jess: for the customer workaround I can ask them to: a) call with the explicit model id `rk-v2-20260221-9fa3b` or b) use alias `redwood/semantic-one` (older reranker) temporarily. I'll send both options.
sam: filing an internal incident / PS ticket and notifying account team; ticket #5123 for customer outreach and rollback timeline.
maria: repoint done — rolled alias redwood/semantic-two -> rk-v2-20260221-9fa3b (cs-9fa3b). Running smoke.
maria: smoke results: rerank returns non-zero scores and ordering as expected for sample queries. No other tenants affected in the immediate neighborhood.
jess: replied to customer with explicit model id workaround and said we reverted the alias. Customer will test and confirm.
jess: customer confirmed: saw expected rerank scores, no more ModelTypeMismatch. Closing escalation after one follow-up.
alex: follow-up action items: add pre-repoint validation, add an alert when alias type changes, and add a short QA step to bulk repoint jobs. I'll own the alert; maria will handle validation and a patch.
maria: noted — I'll open a PR for the validation and add unit tests against model metadata.
jess: thanks everyone :tada: — marking thread resolved on our side.
